clues.it: Anna era accanto a un cavallo, a un pianoforte e nella stessa stanza di Nino.
clues.en: Anna was beside a horse, a piano and in the same room as Nino.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 6ª colonna e nella 2ª riga, ma non era accanto a una sella.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 6th column and in the 2nd row, but was not beside a saddle.

clues.it: Nino era nella 3ª riga, accanto a uno sgabello da saloon e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Nino was in the 3rd row, beside a saloon stool and north of Elena.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era nella 1ª colonna e nella 5ª riga, ma non era accanto a un cactus.
clues.en: Elena was in the 1st column and in the 5th row, but was not beside a cactus.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 5ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e a ovest di Fabio.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 5th column, in the 6th row and west of Fabio.

clues.it: Giada era nella 7ª riga, a ovest di Marta e all'Emporio.
clues.en: Giada was in the 7th row, west of Marta and in the General Store.

clues.it: Marta era nella 8ª riga, ma non era accanto a un cactus.
clues.en: Marta was in the 8th row, but was not beside a cactus.

clues.it: Tea era accanto a una balla di fieno e a nord di Irene.
clues.en: Tea was beside a hay bale and north of Irene.

clues.it: Paolo era a nord di Fabio e all'Emporio.
clues.en: Paolo was north of Fabio and in the General Store.

clues.it: Irene era nella 10ª colonna, nella 11ª riga e accanto a un cactus, ma non era accanto a un cavallo.
clues.en: Irene was in the 10th column, in the 11th row and beside a cactus, but was not beside a horse.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 12ª colonna e accanto a un cactus, ma non era accanto a una balla di fieno.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 12th column and beside a cactus, but was not beside a hay bale.

clues.it: Carla era nella 8ª colonna, nella 13ª riga e in Banca.
clues.en: Carla was in the 8th column, in the 13th row and in the Bank.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

general_clues.it: 1 accanto a una balla di fieno.
1 accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.

steps.it: Solo Anna può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 11ª è sua.
steps.en: Anna is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 11th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 6th.

steps.en: Nino is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 13th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 10ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Paolo's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 10th, column 3rd.
